class.name: HTMLLabel
class.description: Displays [member document] or inline [member text] using [HTMLLayout]. Give the control a size with anchors, offsets, or a parent [Container]. The document wraps to the available width, and scrollbars appear as needed to reach overflowing content. Source changes are applied on a deferred update and reset the scroll position. Resizing recalculates the layout and clamps the current scroll offset. Clicking a [code]#id[/code] link scrolls to the matching HTML element. Connect [signal link_pressed] to handle other links. Drag to select rendered text. The focused control supports the standard select-all and copy shortcuts. The theme color [code]selection_color[/code] sets the selection highlight.

method.name: get_content_size
method.description: Returns the laid-out document size in pixels. Returns [constant Vector2i.ZERO] when there is no valid layout or the document is empty.

method.name: get_element_at
method.description: Returns the element at the given position in this control's local coordinates. The scroll offset is applied automatically. Returns [code]null[/code] outside the content viewport, including the scrollbars, and when there is no hit or the layout is pending.

method.name: get_element_by_id
method.description: Looks up a case-sensitive HTML ID in this label's parsed document. See [method HTMLLayout.get_element_by_id].

method.name: get_render_error
method.description: Returns the latest parsing or layout error, or an empty string on success. Errors are also shown in the editor as node configuration warnings.

method.name: get_scroll_offset
method.description: Returns the horizontal and vertical scroll offset in pixels from the start of the document.

method.name: get_selected_text
method.description: Returns the selected plain text, or an empty string if nothing is selected.

method.name: query_selector
method.description: Returns the first match in this label's parsed document. See [method HTMLLayout.query_selector].

method.name: query_selector_all
method.description: Returns all matches in this label's parsed document. See [method HTMLLayout.query_selector_all].

method.name: scroll_to_anchor
method.description: Scrolls to a laid-out element by its case-sensitive HTML ID. Pass the ID without [code]#[/code]. The vertical alignment ranges from [code]0.0[/code] at the top to [code]1.0[/code] at the bottom and is clamped to the scrollable range. Returns [code]false[/code] if the ID is absent or the layout is pending.

method.name: scroll_to_element
method.description: Scrolls to an element obtained from this label. [param align] positions the element's top from [code]0.0[/code] at the viewport top to [code]1.0[/code] at the viewport bottom, within the scrollable range. Horizontal scrolling adjusts when the target's left edge is outside the viewport. Returns [code]false[/code] for an invalid, foreign, or invisible element, or when layout is pending.

method.name: select_all
method.description: Selects all text in the document.

method.name: set_scroll_offset
method.description: Sets the horizontal and vertical scroll offset in pixels, clamped to the scrollable range. If a layout is pending, the offset is applied after that layout.

members.member: Project resource directory used to resolve relative image paths for [member text]. See [method HTMLLayout.parse] for the supported paths and image formats.
The HTML resource to display. Its source and styles take priority over the local properties. Set this to [code]null[/code] to use [member text], [member base_dir], and [member stylesheet].
Enables text selection. Disabling it clears the current selection.
Additional CSS for [member text], passed to [method HTMLLayout.parse] alongside inline styles and [code]<style>[/code] elements.
The HTML document or fragment to display.

signal.name: link_pressed
signal.description: Emitted when the left mouse button is pressed and released over the same visible link without dragging or scrolling. [param uri] is the link's original [code]href[/code].
